The disciple Huītong joined his palms and prostrated with his head to the ground, tears streaming from his eyes. [He asked: "How may we be spared from such calamities?
"May all sentient beings who have passed away universally recollect Maitreya. Having compared these signs with one another, they are like the land of Wei;
they reside right within it, yet are deluded. In the third and fourth months, the ghost armies will rise in turmoil, boundless and limitless."
In the eighth and ninth months, at the end of the kalpa, when sentient beings practice goodness, the ghost armies will naturally perish.
When heaven and earth are shrouded in darkness, one who obtains and copies this single fascicle shall be spared; one copy shall exempt one household.
Transcribing two copies exempts one from [the karmic retribution of] six kin;
transcribing three copies exempts one from [the retribution of] an entire village.
Those who circulate this are my disciples.
Those who slander this sutra shall enter the Avīci Hell with no prospect of release.
Those who see this sutra but do not transcribe it shall have their entire lineage extinguished.
Those who read and recite this with a sincere heart shall attain the Way of the Buddha.
A black wind rises from the northwest, And ghostly armies surge up from the southeast;
The heavens and earth are forever shrouded in darkness— How could one’s mind find peace?
First one must abstain from alcohol and meat; do not give rise to greed or anger.
If a person can be cautious in these matters, the Way of the Buddha will be attained at once.
[May it] rescue all sentient beings from all suffering and hardship. *Jiuzhuzhongshengyiqiekunan jing*, one fascicle.
